conditions.network: IPv4 loopback, two HTTP/1.1 or WebSocket hops, warmed connections, no TLS on measured hops
conditions.authority: Publicly configured versioned direct OpenAI openai-responses rev1 video jobs and Azure-v1 Responses rev1 realtime; real isolated PostgreSQL, local scripted provider and bounded media spool. Concurrent 4MiB parsers use distinct equally authorized API keys because one API key may hold only one parser lease.
conditions.media: 4 MiB original image input reference; accepted video creation, one 50% partial status, one complete status, exact 1 MiB content retrieval. Slow reader delays 250us after each 8 KiB read.
conditions.duplex: 64 exact native JSON/audio exchanges with independent RTT and successive absolute RTT-difference jitter measurements; provider observes client closure
conditions.resources: Process CPU, allocations and sampled heap include client, fixture, gateway or relay and checks; PostgreSQL is separate. Spool high water and final reservation are observed from the public harness.
conditions.ordering: Fixed sequential workload/path/concurrency order, three repetitions, eight successful workflows each; negative controls run outside timed samples
conditions.scope: Scripted native transport and durable media lifecycle; not live-model quality, WAN, encrypted translated-tool state, or partial batch item errors
